pending.body: Your check-in and grace period expired. We have asked your Trusted Social Confirmers to verify your status before {{deadline}}. Click "{{button}}" to cancel immediately.

confirmers.title: Trusted Social Confirmers (Anti-False-Trigger)
confirmers.subtitle: Up to 2 trusted relatives/friends who will receive an emergency confirmation email (72h window) before your Executor is activated.
confirmers.empty: No trusted confirmers configured yet. Add up to 2 contacts below so accidental missed check-ins (e.g., travel or hospital stay) can be postponed by 7 days.
confirmers.missingFields: Please enter both name and email for your trusted confirmer.

done.aliveTitle: Thank You — Owner Marked as Safe
done.aliveBody: We have postponed the owner's Dead Man's Switch activation by 7 days and sent them a reminder to check in.
done.unreachableTitle: Thank You — Digital Executor Has Been Notified
done.unreachableBody: We have recorded your confirmation and notified the owner's designated Digital Executor to begin the legal verification process.
done.errorTitle: Confirmation Link Could Not Be Verified
done.errorGeneric: This confirmation link is no longer valid.
done.errorHint: If the owner still needs your confirmation, please use the most recent email from LegacyVault.
